## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `1717dffd0e3abf7b48cca30ad073428ecd11f134`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md + docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md (rule 2 and the extraction clause, the declared twin), scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs (the CEILINGS row and its header's raise rule), scripts/pm/issue-create.mjs, scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs, scripts/pm/close-cards.mjs, scripts/pm/write-pace.mjs (the write doors the SKILL names), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/rest-channel.md, execution-duties.md, dispatch-runbook.md, contract-review.md, .claude/agents/os-dev.md and AGENTS.md (the rules the SKILL's dispatch and write rules lean on); card #25807 body and all 18 comments. The remainder of the diff, docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json, is the lane seat's ACCEPT at TIER_DEFAULT and was read only to judge the hits.

Inputs: the card and every comment, the PR body, file list and net diff against main, the check-runs on the head, and the head's files read with git show. Nothing built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept-set change: none. Four files; none under a published package. `.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md` carries `metadata.internal: true` and ships to no customer project; `docs/qa/**` and `scripts/pm/**` are repo tooling; the ledger JSON is read by `scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` and `scripts/checklist-select.mjs` only. No `packages/*` path, no `exports` map, no Zod schema, no error code. Judged right.
- Public-surface change: none published. Judged right.
- Governed-surface change: one Tier S path, `.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md` (the `.claude/**` register row). No Tier H path. Head repo equals base repo (not a fork). The PR is draft and nothing is armed. Judged right.
- Gate change: the `CEILINGS` row for the SKILL moves 238 to 246 in `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`. Measured on the trees: the SKILL is 238 lines on `origin/main` (ce9bc104) and at the merge-base (1c632311), 246 at the head; delta +8, row moved by exactly 8, no other CEILINGS row touched (the diff is one row plus its comment). Not a `CROSS_FILE_MOVES` destination, so no `ruledRaises` record is owed. Longest line the diff adds is 118 bytes against the 120-byte `MAX_LINE_BYTES` budget. The gate itself ran green inside the required `Lint & Repo Gates` (lint.yml step id `pm-skill-line-ratchet`). Judged right.
- Check-runs on the head: `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core` (and 4 shards), `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Check Documentation Links`, `Check PR Size`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, the three branch-claim guards and `Auto Label` all `success`. `Build Core`, `Lint UI`, `Type Check UI`, `Test UI`, `Build & E2E UI`, `Check Changeset` are `skipped` by paths filter or label, the expected reading for a docs-and-skill diff. Three `cancelled` runs (single-writer path, Part-of PR, card-claims-branch) are each superseded by a same-name `success` on the same head. No red.

### ② Semver level

- `skip-changeset` label present; no `.changeset/*.md`; no released package moves. Correct: the label is for a diff that publishes nothing from any released package, and this is one.
- Clause-②: no. Metadata-protocol: none. Both match the diff: nothing an author can write changes, no accept set widens or narrows.
- Served tier is `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` on the rules face (one governed path), not on any narrowing declaration.

### ③ Boundary flags

- PR author login: `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (relay write; no off-relay author to name). Implementing session and adopting seat are the same session, `session_012YjcDon6BvR9MN93ZsFq3U`; per contract-review.md the ④ pass is run by an isolated subagent other than the drafter, fed only the card, the PR and the head, which is how this record was produced.
- Body flag 「`.claude/**` 是受管面(Tier S),这是 PM 自己的工具 PR,按约定留给你审阅合并」: answered. This record is the Tier S record of record for head 1717dffd; it arms nothing. pm-dispatch SKILL.md line 208 (「PM 自己的工具 PR 留维护者」) keeps the landing with the maintainer regardless, so the body's handoff is the correct one.
- PM red line (pm-dispatch 红线: 「PM 永不写代码、不写文件;唯一例外是维护者逐 PR 明示授权的 `.claude/` 内部工具 PR。该例外的 PR 授权原话引在正文」): the body quotes the authorizing word, 「以上应该写入你的 checklist skills」, and the card carries it verbatim in comment 6433562861. Satisfied for the SKILL, its RUNNER twin and the ratchet row, which are one change.
- Line-ratchet flag: the body quotes ruling comment id 6433562861 and delta +8. Verified against the card: that comment records, verbatim and in order, the four maintainer rulings (「你是跑测试啊,和车道有什么关系」, 「你应该使用 pm-dispatch 技能写入」, 「测试结果怎样,测试中遇到的问题应该创建 issue」, 「如果有安全问题不能写issue的,直接派卡修复」 / 「使用 pm-dispatch 技能 派卡修复」) and the order that writes them into this file (「以上应该写入你的 checklist skills」). The eight added lines are exactly those four rules (2 + 3 + 2 + 1 lines); no line the ruling did not order rides the raise. Verified.
- Body claim that 「同意」 to the ledger edit is recorded in comment 6433562861: not so. That comment predates #26497 and carries no 「同意」; the only two 「同意」 lines on the card are for the wave-2 plan (6433473244) and the per-area pin-upgrade cards (6437424356). The ledger edit needs no ruling (SKILL §3: a run's checklist edit is an ordinary edit; #26453's Landed comment names it as the follow-up owed after #26497), so the edit stands, but the attribution is wrong. should-fix: correct the PR body's provenance line (quote where the word was given, or drop the attribution). Body only, no tree change.
- Local verification lines in the body (`check-platform-checklist`, `check-doc-authoring`, `check-skill-id-lint`): not relied on; the head's check-runs are the verdicts and they agree.
- Open questions: none declared in the body; none raised by a dev report (this is a seat-authored PR, no `os-dev-report`).

### ④ Design judgment

`.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md`, hunk by hunk, against the code and rules it cites:

- §2 「QA 运行不是车道卡」 — runners dispatched directly by the session that starts the round, no lane claim or seat post; pm-dispatch governs only the write doors and the security fix dispatch. Holds. A run record is `qa-run`, excluded from the backlog sweep and 「不是可派发单元」 (SKILL §4 label rule, RUNNER extraction clause, unchanged); pm-dispatch's claim protocol, `batch` cap and `os-verify-lock` depth all key on dispatched dev cards, which a runner is not. Wave 2 ran exactly this way (one `create_session` per card, comment 6433473244). AGENTS.md's claim-before-code rule is not touched: a runner writes no card code; a §3 ledger edit rides a PR that `Refs` the anchor, as this one does. No contradiction found.
- §4 write-door paragraph — `scripts/pm/issue-create.mjs`, `post-stamped.mjs`, `close-cards.mjs`, `write-pace.mjs --announce-batch N`, run from the repo root, fleet relay inside a cloud container; never MCP `issue_write` or bare curl; a refused write is not worked around. Every named door exists and takes what the text says: `issue-create.mjs --repo --title-file --body-file [--label]` (header line 7; `--label` carries `qa-run`), `post-stamped.mjs --comment=N --file=` (line 7), `close-cards.mjs --repo --plan` (line 13; a `qa-run` record carries no pm-state, so a close takes `--stateless`, a detail the SKILL correctly leaves to the door's header), `write-pace.mjs --announce-batch N --kind` (line 10, `KNOWN_FLAGS`). 「仓根直调」 is close-cards' own usage rule; 「云容器内自走 fleet relay」 is `OS_FLEET_TRANSPORT=auto` (issue-create header) and rest-channel.md's three-condition `dispatch` rule; 「锁 1 已拒」 is the same refusal rest-channel.md line 43 records. The replaced line (「经 REST 代理 POST .../issues 立单」) contradicted AGENTS.md's 「Every GitHub write leaves through scripts/pm/」; the new text removes that contradiction. Holds.
- Guardrail 「每个产品问题同一轮经 §4 立 issue」 — holds against §5's four-way disposition: only the 产品缺陷 quadrant is a product defect; assertion defects, stale specs and invalid pairings keep their own exits, and checklist-accuracy findings still close out on the anchor. RUNNER's extraction clause says the same in English (「Every product defect the run meets, a clause fail or an off-clause probe finding alike, is extracted in the same run」). Same rule, both places.
- Guardrail auth/authz — compared line by line with RUNNER.md rule 2 at the head: never publish the reproduction anywhere on GitHub; the card carries only item id, clause and `detail withheld pending maintainer`; the reproduction stays in the runner session; the fix is dispatched directly through pm-dispatch as an in-seat `mode:subagent` `os-dev` whose prompt alone carries the reproduction; never waiting on the maintainer; a one-shot runner with no dispatch channel hands it to the session that dispatched it. The two texts say the same thing; RUNNER adds the provenance (disclosure ruling on #9387, fix-dispatch ruling on #25807) and the term 「disclosure-discipline card」, which is pm-dispatch's own (dispatch-runbook.md line 133: 「披露纪律卡(私密细节不得离开席位会话)也留席内,认领写明」) and is the explicit exception to the project-thread rule that would otherwise send a `security` card to `mode:thread` (SKILL.md line 61, runbook line 131). Consistent.
  - Against the human floor (pm-dispatch SKILL.md lines 214, 216, 264: 「修复以猜测…定安全边界 ⇒ 决策卡先比对声明式方案」, 「安全/权限边界…恒在人工地板」): no contradiction. The new rule governs the dispatch act, and it goes 「经 pm-dispatch」, so pm-dispatch's escalation rules travel with it: a dispatched fix that would set a boundary by guess still lands a decision card, and the maintainer's word on the dispatch act itself is the ruling of record (priority order: 维护者裁决 above 细则). The scenario it is accepted against ran on #26453: filed 04:13 with `bug`+`security` and the withheld marker, claimed 04:15 as `M`, `mode:subagent` (disclosure-discipline card), the claim quoting 「如果有安全问题不能写issue的,直接派卡修复」 with its provenance, fixed by #26497, merged 06:34 through the queue, detail still withheld. The design holds on its first consumer.
  - The marker string `detail withheld pending maintainer` beside 「⛔ 不等维护者」 reads correctly: the detail is what pends (disclosed to the maintainer only); the fix does not. The marker is grep-able protocol vocabulary already on #26453 and is rightly left unchanged.
  - should-fix (non-blocking, pm-dispatch side): execution-duties.md admits an untriaged card as a dispatch candidate only as a sub-issue, a main-red anchor, or a 「维护者直派插队卡(出处三件)」. The security card path works through the third (the #26453 claim did exactly that: ruling quoted verbatim, who, where), but neither the SKILL nor pm-dispatch says so in words. One line, in whichever file the seat prefers, under the same ruling; at headroom 0 it costs a deletion or its own measured raise.
  - should-fix (non-blocking, dispatch-prompt side): 「复现只进派发令」 binds where the PM puts the reproduction, and os-dev.md carries no standing disclosure line, so what the dispatched dev may write into the PR body, changeset and test names is held by the dispatch prompt alone. #26497 held it (「细节按维护者裁决不公开」). Worth stating in the dispatch-order text the seat uses for these cards; no change to this diff is required.
- Ratchet row — read as one change with the rule: the header's raise discipline (ruling of record quoted by id, measured delta in the body, row moved by at most the delta, in the same PR) is met on every count, as measured in ①. The row's comment names the ruling and the four rules it orders, which is the declaration the header asks of a raise.
- Out of this diff, recorded for a separate card and carrying no weight here: SKILL §1 (lines 68 to 69) and §4 (line 140) still name `.objectui-sha` and `pnpm objectui:build`; on `origin/main` the pin file is absent and the script is `console:build` (comment 6433473244 already records that the Console is built in-repo). Pre-existing text, untouched by this PR.

`docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md` (widened in): rule 2 and the extraction clause carry the same rule as the SKILL, checked above; the new provenance line names the comment on #25807 that exists. Holds.

No must-fix. Three should-fixes, none a tree defect in the hits: one PR-body provenance correction, two one-line clarifications that belong to pm-dispatch's own text and the dispatch order, not to this diff.

Implemented-by: `claude/sweet-fermat-jrcd80`
Reviewed-by: `session_012YjcDon6BvR9MN93ZsFq3U`

**VERDICT: PASS**
